perm.title: Permissions
perm.intro: To pause distracting apps during focus, Flowa needs a few permissions. We only use them for blocking — nothing is collected or shared.
perm.accessibility_desc: The main switch. Lets Flowa notice the instant a blocked app opens so it can pause it. Enable "Flowa Focus Blocking" in the list. Flowa never reads screen content.
perm.overlay_desc: Allows the calm "Stay focused" screen to appear on top of a blocked app.
perm.miui_popup_desc: Xiaomi only: enable "Display pop-up windows while running in the background", or the focus screen can't appear over a blocked app.
perm.miui_autostart_desc: Xiaomi only: turn on Autostart so the blocker keeps running in the background and isn't killed.
perm.usage_desc: A backup way to detect the foreground app if Accessibility is off. Optional but recommended.
